text: A staff that speaks all six voices. Choose one, point, and cast.
It spends Pulse from a Pulse Cell, never durability, and can carry a cell of its own like [Spiritgear](spiritgear).

pages.title: The six spells
text: Crouch and use to cycle Earth, Fire, Water, Air, Spirit and Loom; the action bar names the voice. Use to cast. The **Staff: next voice** key cycles without the crouch once you bind it under Tribal Power in Controls.
- **Earth** (12 Pulse): a 4-damage blow that slows the foe heavily for 5 seconds.
- **Fire** (18): an 8-damage strike that sets the foe alight for 4 seconds.
- **Water** (24): heals and cleanses you. It puts out fire, clears poison, and gives regeneration for 5 seconds and water breathing for 30.
- **Air** (16): a short leap forward and slow falling for 6 seconds.
- **Spirit** (20): night sight for 30 seconds, and every hostile within **12 blocks** glows for 12.
- **Loom** (6): tethers a foe, drawing it up to **8 blocks** toward you.

pages.title: Stitching
text: With Loom chosen, crouch-use when no foe is in your sights and no block is close ahead: the staff **stitches** you **6 blocks** forward through open air for **10 Pulse**. It refuses to land you in solid blocks or hazards.
Because of that, to cycle on from Loom, look at a nearby block or a foe while you crouch-use.

pages.title: Reach and rest
text: Earth, Fire and Loom need a hostile target. They reach **18 blocks** and stop at solid blocks; with no target they do not fire and cost nothing.
After a cast the staff rests: **8 seconds** after Water, **2 seconds** after the others, **1.5 seconds** after a stitch.
It drinks from its own seated cell first, then from the cells you carry, offhand first. If they are all dry, the cast does not fire.
While **Unsung Hush** is on you the staff will not cast (see [Afflictions](afflictions)).
